method.neighborRule: Keep the established pool first. Only candidate_graph_exhausted with time remaining can trigger a larger pool; skip solving it when no candidates were added. method.ablation: Eight explicitly labelled boundary/junction variants. No known hidden connector or sheet ownership is passed to HiGHS.

oracle.scope: Per-graph conditional retry before the later feature-recovery scheduling fix. The final release also defers expansion across border hypotheses and skips connector-independent margin contradictions. This older gallery replay does not exercise the later scheduling and margin guards.
limitations: Clean square gallery renderings only; no photograph crop or colour-classification evaluation.
